name: England
source: The FA's numbered misconduct codes; checked against halfline.app/codes on 2026-10-26.

cautions.description: Failure to respect the required distance at a restart
Entering or re-entering the field of play without permission
Deliberately leaving the field of play without permission

sendOffs.description: Spitting at an opponent or any other person
Denying a goal or an obvious goal-scoring opportunity by a deliberate handball
Denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity by an offense punishable by a free kick or penalty
Offensive, insulting or abusive language or gestures
Second caution in the same match
